note: Gate D W2 — D03 (Player Detail Development/AI hypothesis) and D06 (Player intelligence, cross-source hypothesis), deferred from Wave 1 (PR #844, merged/approved 2026-11-25). Seven candidates total: three D03 states (grounded longitudinal hypothesis, sparse no-hypothesis, coach decision flow), four D06 states (coherent synthesis, genuine contradiction, sparse cross-source, source inspection + confirmation). Every interactive candidate reuses the real, unmodified AssistantCoachHypothesisPanel via a new fixture-safe actions override mount (AssistantCoachHypothesisMount), following the exact Gate C W3 C07 RSC-boundary pattern. EvidenceSourceInspector (source-linking) and NoDefensibleHypothesis (honest insufficiency state) are new, explicitly disclosed directional presentations — no equivalent exists in production today (see CURRENT_STATE_AUDIT.md); both disclosed production gaps are filed as GitHub issues #845 and #846 rather than fixed in this UI-Lab-only wave. No production code changed anywhere in this wave. scripts/ui-lab-visual-review.mjs registers all seven routes for CI capture. All candidates are CANDIDATE, pending owner review — none approved, none merged, none self-approved. The `assistantCoachState` field below uses descriptive values (ACTIVE / EMPTY) consistent with this field's apparent intent in Wave 1's manifest, since every Wave 1 entry used NOT_APPLICABLE (none of Wave 1's scenarios involved Assistant Coach) and no other value was ever established — disclosed here rather than silently copied from an inapplicable precedent. REMEDIATION (independent review, same PR): GATE-D-W2-D06-COHERENT and GATE-D-W2-D06-SOURCE-INSPECTION's hypothesis statements reworded the awkward bare-code parenthetical ('(profile role: F)' reading oddly beside 'centre forward' in prose) into a clearer 'in 14-role profile terms, from profile role: X to profile role: Y' construction; fixtureVersion bumped to 2 on both (derivation and test coverage unchanged). REMEDIATION (owner review, same PR, 2026-11-25): four evidence-fidelity findings corrected — (1) GATE-D-W2-D03-DECISION-FLOW had no EvidenceSourceMap at all backing its four cited refs; added, fixtureVersion bumped to 2. (2) evidence-source-detail.tsx's pill label was provenance-derived, mislabelling a HUMAN_ASSESSMENT as 'Recorded fact'; corrected to a kind-derived label across all seven real EvidenceRef kinds (no fixtureVersion impact — shared-component fix, not a fixture-data change; GATE-D-W2-D06-COHERENT, -CONTRADICTION, and -SOURCE-INSPECTION's own fixture data/hashes are unchanged, but their screenshots now show the corrected label). (3) GATE-D-W2-D03-GROUNDED mislabelled a raw count as a 'rate'; corrected to a count with an exposure-normalization caveat, fixtureVersion bumped to 2. (4) GATE-D-W2-D03-GROUNDED's page stated an incorrect 'five-week' duration for an actual six-week window; corrected to a value computed from the fixture's own date boundaries. Full account: docs/ui-lab/gate-d-w2-candidates/DATA_TRUTH_AND_FIXTURES.md, BLOCKERS.md, REVIEW_RECORD.md. A prior version of this note prematurely claimed a fresh attestation already existed before one had actually been produced — flagged BLOCKING by an independent review of this remediation and corrected. capture-attestation.json now reflects a real, independently re-verified CI capture run against the actual remediated code (CI 45706210938, after two further attempts documented in full in REVIEW_RECORD.md — one canceled by a concurrency collision, one that found and required fixing a genuine Playwright test bug of its own), superseding the stale pre-remediation attestation (CI run 45643162459, commit 40bdff67). REMEDIATION (owner review, same PR, 2026-11-26): two unsupported cross-player claims corrected — (1) GATE-D-W2-D03-DECISION-FLOW dismissHypothesis claimed several teammates showed the same pattern while its own missingEvidence disclosed no squad-wide comparison existed; corrected to describe only Amir Haile's own recorded numbers, fixtureVersion bumped to 3. (2) GATE-D-W2-D03-GROUNDED cycleInsight claimed a squad-wide recurring theme with no supporting records for any player other than Jonas Berg; corrected to a player-specific interpretation, fixtureVersion bumped to 3. A bounded audit of the other five Wave 2 scenarios (D03-SPARSE, D06-COHERENT, D06-CONTRADICTION, D06-SPARSE, D06-SOURCE-INSPECTION) found no instance of the same defect class — every claim in those fixtures is already player-specific and traceable to its own cited sources. Full account: REVIEW_RECORD.md.
